changelog: - **A marketing tenant's company list and stage board stop speaking mentorship** (#2426, #2427, story #2394). `src/i18n/verticalOverlays.ts` gains MARKETING overrides for `companiesPage`, `board`, `adminBoard` and the two empty states those screens render (`emptyStates.companies.adminBody`, `emptyStates.board.adminBody`) in EN/TR/DE: the page subtitle ("…their internship needs"), the company-login hint, the two counter badges (`mentorships`/`positions` → deals/needs), `board.emptyStage`, the board subtitle and search placeholder ("Find a mentee or mentor…"), the WIP-saturation note and all three group headings. `adminBoard.groups.custom` is included because MARKETING_FUNNEL's stage keys are its own (`LEAD_*`/`DEAL_*`), so `groupResolvedStages()` files every column under `custom` — "Custom stages" was the one heading a provisioned marketing tenant actually saw; `pre`/`internship` are still overridden for an org switched to MARKETING while sitting on the canonical stage keys. No new dictionary key, no new table and no second translation layer for stage names: those come from the template's own `labels` through `stageLabel()`. `e2e/vertical-terminology.spec.ts` now visits both screens as a MARKETING admin (with the vertical's stage preset seeded, as `provisionStagePreset()` writes it) and asserts the rendered text of the content region matches no mentorship word, plus the mirror assertions that an INTERNSHIP admin still reads the original strings.

en: A marketing organisation's company list and stage board now speak its own language — accounts, leads and deals — instead of mentorships, mentees and internships.
tr: Pazarlama organizasyonunun firma listesi ve aşama panosu artık kendi dilini konuşuyor: mentorluk, mentee ve staj yerine müşteri hesabı, müşteri adayı ve fırsat.
de: Unternehmensliste und Phasen-Board einer Marketing-Organisation sprechen jetzt ihre eigene Sprache — Accounts, Leads und Deals statt Mentorings, Mentees und Praktika.
